text: The aspiring photographer Joanna Eberhart moves with her husband Walter and their two daughters from Manhattan to [Stepford, Connecticut|trigger|making a new home], where the women all look flawless and talk only of housework. Walter joins the exclusionary Men's Association, while Joanna and [her friend Bobbie Markowe|who_suffers|friends and companions] wonder why every wife there was once strong and independent. When [Bobbie abruptly becomes another conformist housewife|threat|impostors and doubles], Joanna begins to believe that [the men of the town|wants|power over others] are altering the minds of the women.
